bio: Located just off the reception area of the tasteful and well-appointed Hotel Colani, Colani Bistrot is the alternative to the fine dining restaurant. The food served here – Mediterranean cuisine with a local twist. We can certainly recommend the Ravioli of the Day. Meat eaters should ask about the main dish centred on venison or veal – showcasing a different cut every day. Friendly service, a laid-back atmosphere and modern interior design featuring light wood and a whole host of decorative details....
